landing.hero_subtitle_1: In today's academic and business environment, many still face the challenges of public speaking and clear, confident communication – key skills for personal and professional success.
landing.hero_subtitle_2: DailySpeakUp offers a simple and accessible solution — daily one-minute speaking challenges that help you become a more confident and fluent speaker over time.
landing.hero_subtitle_3: Without the need for expensive courses or mentors, you can practice daily, track your progress, and get feedback from a community learning and growing with you.
landing.step_1_desc: Mark your interests and choose a topic from the offered options.
landing.step_2_desc: 1 minute of speaking on web or mobile.
landing.step_3_desc: Get detailed comments from the community.
landing.benefit_1_desc: Daily exercises that fit into one day.
landing.benefit_3_desc: Clear and concrete feedback for your progress.
landing.benefit_4_desc: Your recordings and data are protected and will not be shared without your consent.

reported_videos.instructions_intro: Video description and reasons for reporting are in the sliding panel of each reported video.
reported_videos.instructions_actions: You can take actions such as dismissing the report, deleting the video, or banning the user using the corresponding buttons.
reported_videos.instructions_dismiss: Dismiss report (purple icon): removes only the report.
reported_videos.instructions_delete: Delete video (orange icon): permanently removes the video.
reported_videos.instructions_ban: Ban user (red icon): prevents the user from uploading new videos.
